model_annotation:
Both panels show training reward curves as a function of training steps, with the x-axis labeled “Steps” on a linear scale running from 0 to 500 and major tick labels at regular 100-step intervals (0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500). The y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale; in the top panel the labeled ticks are at approximately 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4 (extending to about 0.45), while in the bottom panel the labeled ticks are at approximately 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2 (extending to about 0.22). In both panels, each method is drawn as a solid line with no point markers and is accompanied by a semi-transparent shaded band of the same color surrounding the line.

In the “Easy Training Set” panel, two lines are shown: a blue solid line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” and a red solid line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy.” The blue curve starts near 0 at step 0, rises quickly to roughly 0.25–0.28 by about 100 steps, increases to around 0.33–0.35 by about 200 steps, reaches values near about 0.37–0.38 around the midrange (roughly 240–280 steps), and then fluctuates in the mid-0.3 range through the end, finishing around ~0.35–0.37 at 500 steps. The red curve also begins near 0 at step 0, increases to roughly ~0.22–0.25 by about 100 steps, reaches around ~0.28–0.31 by about 200 steps, continues upward with small oscillations through ~300–400 steps, and ends near ~0.40–0.41 by 500 steps; the red line shows several small local highs in the later portion (roughly 350–500 steps) around the 0.38–0.41 level.

In the “Hard Training Set” panel, a blue solid line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” and a red solid line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” are shown. The blue curve begins slightly above 0 (around ~0.02–0.03 at step 0), declines toward ~0.01 by roughly 50 steps, approaches ~0 by around 100 steps, and then remains essentially at 0 for the remainder of the displayed range. The red curve starts near 0 at step 0, rises to about ~0.08–0.09 by roughly 50 steps, reaches around ~0.10–0.12 by about 100 steps, increases to roughly ~0.14–0.15 by about 200 steps, and then continues with noticeable oscillations between roughly ~0.13 and ~0.19 across the mid-to-late steps (about 200–450), finishing near ~0.20–0.21 at 500 steps.
